Definition: from G1722 and G2480; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.
BiblicalUsage: To strengthen, to invigorate. Saul received meat and was strengthened in Acts 9:19, and an angel appeared to Jesus in Gethsemane, strengthening Him, in Luke 22:43.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength comes in the darkest hours — to a blinded Saul after three days without food, and to Jesus on the night before the cross — and God still sends it by food and by angels.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane; The Conversion of Paul
